Dana / ClearHealth procurement team —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attached is a working Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v2.xlsx) and a companion CSV that lists the proposed acceptance tests. We want to make sure we capture ClearHealth's exit gates and edge-case tests explicitly so the pilot's pass/fail outcome is unambiguous. High-level ask: please review the acceptance criteria below and confirm owners and a go/no-go signoff date.

Proposed acceptance checklist (pilot window = 2 weeks):
- Functional correctness: >= 92% accuracy on ClearHealth human-reviewed eval set (50 queries) with documented failure modes. Owner: ClearHealth QA + Redwood reliability.
- Latency SLA: median request latency < 120ms; p99 < 600ms under pilot concurrency (target concurrency = 12). Owner: Redwood engineering.
- Cost profile: average token cost per session <= $0.015 (projected tokens shown in MAP_v2.xlsx). Owner: Redwood finance.
- Safety & privacy: no retention of raw PHI in logs; KMS-backed keys for any customer data at rest. Owner: ClearHealth security + Redwood security.
- Robustness/edge-cases: fallback behavior when model returns hallucinations, and recovery for truncated responses (see acceptance-tests.csv for specific probes). Owner: Product + ClearHealth ops.

If any criteria above are blockers, call them out and propose an alternate threshold. Next steps I propose:
1) ClearHealth to confirm owners and add any missing acceptance tests by EOD Thu (2027-08-12).
2) Redwood to run a smoke suite (3-day) and share results in shared doc.
3) Signoff target: Tue 2027-08-24 (or earlier if tests pass).

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (mutual action plan with owners/timeline), acceptance-tests.csv (detailed probes).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HC-5821

Thanks —

Dana / Tim —

Thanks for the feedback — we've incorporated the latency bands and the spike reliability test into version 2 of the MAP (attached). Quick notes on responsibilities and acceptance scoring so signoff is operationally clean:

- Acceptance rubric (pass/fail windows):
  * Green (Pass): meets all primary criteria and <=1 minor failure across 50 queries.
  * Amber (Remediate): one primary criterion missed OR 2-3 minor failures; requires a 7-day remediation window with a repeat smoke test.
  * Red (Fail): more than one primary criterion missed OR >3 minor failures; triggers pause and root-cause.

- Mapping to tests (examples):
  * Accuracy: 50-query human-reviewed set (ClearHealth QA) — score >=92% => pass.
  * Latency: production-like replay using ClearHealth trace sample (ben will run this w/ our infra).
  * Edge-case probes: malformed inputs, truncated context, and prompt-injection style probes (acceptance-tests.csv).

We can drive the initial smoke suite on Wed-Thu. Ben will run the replay and spike tests and I'll coordinate documentation for SOC2 excerpts we can share. For contracting, I pushed a DocuSign SOW draft into the HubSpot deal — link in the MAP. If procurement is ready to issue a PO, please attach it and we'll schedule the pilot kickoff immediately after.
